content.value: Coins are kept in your wallet rather than occupying item slots. The wallet panel beside your equipped bags shows the balance, and coins remain with you on death.

Fight eligible hostile creatures through active player combat. Coin eligibility follows combat XP rules: ordinary passive animals, unattended kills and spawner creatures are not a repeatable coin source. Generated treasure can also award coins when opened; player-placed storage does not create fresh treasure rewards.
Eligible participants share a fixed coin reward total. A larger party does not multiply the amount of money dropped by one creature, even though combat XP has its own party bonus.

Click the wallet to find a nearby player to trade with. Both players must be close, visible to one another and in the same dimension. The [[article/trading|trade interface]] exchanges items and coins without dropping them on the ground.
